reading.zh: 这份 1650 行的存储测试模块按类顺序阅读：基础路径与大文件、命名与 IO、链接与属性、维护、裸设备访问、空间耗尽、四组卷模式、身份、磁盘管理器、并发、权限、向量盘、日志盘，最后是 CLI 契约。
reading.en: The single 1650-line storage test module, read in class order: basic paths and large files, naming and IO, links and attributes, maintenance, raw device access, space exhaustion, the four volume-mode groups, identity, the disk manager, concurrency, permissions, vector disk, log disk and finally the CLI contract.
